headline: Iran expands communications and transit ties with Armenia
summary: Iranian Minister Seyed Sattar Hashemi visited Yerevan for ministerial talks to deepen telecommunications and trade corridor cooperation between Iran and Armenia.
why: The TRIPP transport initiative aims to build regional infrastructure linking Iranian ports to European routes via Armenia.

impacts.name: Armenia
impacts.why: Expanding regional telecommunications links enhances regional commercial connectivity.
